content.short: SnapX is an AI-powered social trading platform on TON featuring 'social mining' and tap-to-earn mechanics.
content.description: SnapX is an innovative SocialFi application that combines AI-driven market insights with social engagement on the TON blockchain. It features a unique 'social mining' model where users can earn rewards by sharing trading signals and participating in the platform's tap-to-earn mini-games. SnapX aims to democratize professional trading tools for the Telegram community, providing users with automated signals, portfolio analysis, and a rewarding social environment where financial influence is directly incentivized through the network's native tokens.
content.meta: Join the social trading revolution with SnapX on TON. AI signals and social rewards on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
